# A loGo/s importer consumes assertion effects from a `lang go`
# member: instantiating a proven-zero Go generic with a readonly
# interface argument compiles only when the importer applies the
# recorded AssertTP=0,AssertRTP=0 effects; without them the build
# fails with an unverified-effects error.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/al.a ./al/lib
go tool pack p $WORK/al.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Identity AssertTP=0,AssertRTP=0$'
stdout '^lang go$'

cd ac
logos build -o $WORK/bin/assert$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/assert$GOEXE
stdout '^thing$'
cd ..
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./al
	./ac
)

-- w/al/go.mod --
module example.com/alg

go 1.27

-- w/al/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Identity[T any](x T) T { return x }

type Person struct {
	N string
}

func (p Person) Name() string {
	return p.N
}

-- w/ac/go.mod --
module example.com/acimp

go 1.27

require example.com/alg v0.0.0

replace example.com/alg => ../al

-- w/ac/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/alg/lib"
)

type ROI interface {
	const Name() string
}

type Thing struct{}

func (Thing) Name() string {
	return "thing"
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(lib.Identity[ROI](Thing{}).Name())
}
